# Micropay

> Pay-per-use AI for chat, image generation, and speech-to-text. Settle each request in USDC on Algorand via the x402 protocol (GoPlausible facilitator). No subscriptions or prepaid API keys.

Micropay exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API and a web app. Clients connect an Algorand wallet, approve the quoted USDC amount, and receive the model response after settlement.

## Product

- Chat completions (streaming SSE supported) across a diverse catalog of popular models
- Image generation (base64 PNG / b64_json)
- Audio transcription (multipart upload → text)
- Wallet-native USDC micropayments on Algorand Mainnet via x402

## Paid HTTP endpoints (x402)

- POST /api/v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-compatible chat completions; optional stream
- POST /api/v1/images/generations — OpenAI-compatible image generation (b64_json)
- POST /api/v1/audio/transcriptions — OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text

Unauthenticated calls receive HTTP 402 with exact payment requirements (USDC ASA on Algorand). Retry with a valid PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after settling through https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz.

## Discovery

- Web app: /
- API reference: /api-reference
- Model catalog: /models
- puya-ts IDE: /ide
- MCP protocol: /mcp

- Machine-readable merchant card: /.well-known/x402.json
- Agent plugin manifest: /.well-known/ai-plugin.json

## Contact / merchant

Merchant identity for x402 Bazaar is the Algorand `payTo` address configured as X402_PAY_TO. Challenge tag: x402-global-challenge.
